name: Cloud Object & Media Storage Service
description: Secure file and media upload manager with presigned S3 URLs, virus scanning, image thumbnail generation, and access-controlled downloads.

clarifying_questions.question: Upload flow architecture?
options: Direct client-to-S3 via Presigned PUT/POST URL
Proxied server upload with stream forwarding
clarifying_questions.impacts: Sets up presigned URL generation endpoint vs streaming endpoint

clarifying_questions.question: Automated image processing?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Adds background image transform worker or CDN parameters

known_failure_modes: Routing large binary file uploads through the API backend server consuming memory and worker threads
Trusting user-supplied filename without sanitization causing path traversal vulnerabilities
Making private S3 buckets publicly readable without signed URL authorization checks
